Full aggregate 23064.698676 us; n2048 83343.824 us, about 44 us slower than launch-bounds control, measuring the cost of the runtime fence.

Build passed; resident kernel remains REG94 STACK0/LOCAL0. Caller factor-load window is 40 live GPRs before a 75-GPR call boundary; callee load peak is 54. Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39.
